## Changes

### PR [#2061](https://github.com/danielmiessler/Fabric/pull/2061) by [praxstack](https://github.com/praxstack): fix(chat): prevent streaming deadlock and unify strategy handling

- **Fixed a streaming deadlock in `Chatter.Send`** by introducing `recordFirstStreamError()`, which uses a non-blocking `select/default` to safely send only the first error to the buffered error channel, preventing goroutine leaks when both the `SendStream` goroutine and the stream-update loop attempt to write simultaneously.
- **Unified strategy handling across the CLI and REST API server** by passing `StrategyName` through to `GetChatter()` and `ChatRequest`, ensuring the core `Chatter.BuildSession()` layer handles strategy loading consistently instead of duplicating logic in the server handler.
- **Removed inline `os.ReadFile` strategy loading from the server handler**, which previously bypassed the core Chatter layer, causing strategy prompts to be incorrectly prepended to `UserInput` rather than the system message.
- **Replaced raw string concatenation for system message assembly** with a new `joinPromptSections()` helper that trims whitespace, skips empty sections, and joins strategy, context, and pattern prompts with a single newline separator.
- **Added regression and unit tests**, including a 2-second timeout deadlock test (`TestChatter_Send_StreamingErrorUpdateAndReturnDoesNotDeadlock`), a session-assembly validation test (`TestChatter_BuildSession_SeparatesSystemSections`), and a helper verification test (`TestBuildPromptChatRequest_PreservesStrategyAndUserInput`).

key_changes: 修复了 Chatter.Send 中的流式传输死锁问题，通过引入 recordFirstStreamError() 防止 goroutine 泄漏
统一了 CLI 和 REST API 服务器的策略处理逻辑，确保策略加载在核心层一致处理
修复了服务端策略提示被错误地附加到用户输入而非系统消息的问题
新增了 joinPromptSections() 辅助函数，规范系统消息的组装方式
添加了回归测试和单元测试，包括死锁测试和会话组装验证测试

1. Back up your customized docker-compose YAML file (optional)


2. Get the latest code from the main branch

   ```bash
   git checkout main

   ```

3. Stop the service. Please execute in the docker directory

   ```bash
   docker compose down
   ```

4. Back up data

   ```bash
   tar -cvf volumes-$(date +%s).tgz volumes
   ```


releases.summary:
## 🚀 Major Functional Changes

### Data platform and dataset operations

- Added **Hologres** as a supported backend option for both vector retrieval and full-text search.
- Added Service API endpoints for dataset document downloads:
  - Batch ZIP download for selected documents.
  - Signed URL download for single-document original files.

### Workflow and chat experience improvements

- **Breaking change:** HITL email content now uses markdown rendering before delivery. 
  Existing email templates that relied on raw/plain behavior may render differently after upgrade.
- Draft variables are now user-scoped instead of app-scoped. Historical draft variables will not be available after upgrading.
- Added edge context menu support in workflow canvas, including direct edge deletion.
- Preserved existing connections when changing node types in workflow editing.
- Added configurable send-key behavior (`Enter` vs `Shift+Enter`) for embedded chat input.
- Added file payloads in message-end stream responses.
- Removed GPT-4-specific hardcoded behavior from default model selection logic.
- Added a new `export-app-messages` CLI command to export application messages and related feedback to `JSONL.GZ` (local or cloud storage).

## 🔐 Security Updates

- Prevented SQL injection risks in vector-store query paths by switching to parameterized SQL in affected implementations.
- Hardened HITL email delivery:
  - Sanitize subject and body content.
  - Strip CR/LF from subjects to prevent SMTP header-injection vectors.
- Enforced ownership checks for conversation deletion APIs.
- Cleared stale provider credentials during plugin uninstall to reduce residual credential risk.
- Improved enterprise API error handling and license-enforcement behavior for invalid/expired license states.

## 🏗️ Configuration, Architecture, and Deployment Updates

### Deployment and operations
- Added a dedicated Celery queue: `dataset_summary` for LLM-heavy summary generation tasks.
  - Ensure workers subscribe to this queue to avoid summary-job backlog.
- Added telemetry metrics for retention cleanup tasks (messages/workflow runs), plus flush behavior for short-lived command jobs.

### Configuration changes

- Added `REDIS_MAX_CONNECTIONS`.
- Deprecated `PUBSUB_*` event-bus settings in favor of `EVENT_BUS_*` settings.

## 🛠 Other Noteworthy Changes

- Fixed `workflow_runs.started_at` being overwritten on resume.
- Fixed metadata batch-edit silent failures caused by split-transaction edge cases.
- Fixed metadata filter extraction issues in knowledge retrieval (`{{...}}` conditions).
- Restored citation visibility in advanced chat applications.
- Fixed conversation variable reset behavior after HITL nodes.
- Fixed a page crash in knowledge-retrieval node configuration flow.
- Fixed chat assistant blocking response-mode behavior.
- Added `doc_type` handling in Weaviate vector attributes for better compatibility.
- Upgraded OpenTelemetry dependencies to resolve context-detach errors.

---

## Upgrade Guide

> [!IMPORTANT]
> If you use custom `CELERY_QUEUES`, make sure `workflow_based_app_execution` is included.  
> If `ENABLE_API_TOKEN_LAST_USED_UPDATE_TASK=true`, also include `api_token`.
> 
> For background and details, see **⚠️ Important Upgrade Note** and **🔧 Operational Note** above.

### Docker Compose Deployments

1. Back up your customized docker-compose YAML file (optional)

   ```bash
   cd docker
   cp docker-compose.yaml docker-compose.yaml.$(date +%s).bak
   ```

2. Get the latest code from the main branch

   ```bash
   git checkout main
   git pull origin main
   ```

3. Stop the service. Please execute in the docker directory

   ```bash
   docker compose down
   ```

4. Back up data

   ```bash
   tar -cvf volumes-$(date +%s).tgz volumes
   ```

5. Upgrade services

   ```bash
   docker compose up -d
   ```

> [!NOTE]
> 
> If you encounter errors like below
> 
> ```bash
> 2025/11/26 11:37:57 /app/internal/db/pg/pg.go:30
> [error] failed to initialize database, got error failed to connect to `host=db_postgres user=postgres database=dify_plugin`: hostname resolving error (lookup db_postgres on 127.0.0.11:53: server misbehaving)
> 
> 2025/11/26 11:37:57 /app/internal/db/pg/pg.go:34
> [error] failed to initialize database, got error failed to connect to `host=db_postgres user=postgres database=postgres`: hostname > resolving error (lookup db_postgres on 127.0.0.11:53: server misbehaving)
> 2025/11/26 11:37:57 init.go:99: [PANIC]failed to init dify plugin db: failed to connect to `host=db_postgres user=postgres database=postgres`: hostname resolving error (lookup db_postgres on 127.0.0.11:53: server misbehaving)
> panic: [PANIC]failed to init dify plugin db: failed to connect to `host=db_postgres user=postgres database=postgres`: hostname resolving error (lookup db_postgres on 127.0.0.11:53: server misbehaving)
> ```
> Please use the following command instead. For details, please read this https://github.com/langgenius/dify/issues/28706
>    ```bash
>    docker compose --profile postgresql up -d
>    ```

### Source Code Deployments

1. Stop the API server, Worker, and Web frontend Server.

2. Get the latest code from the release branch:

   ```bash
   git checkout 1.13.1
   ```

3. Update Python dependencies:

   ```bash
   cd api
   uv sync
   ```

4. Then, let's run the migration script:

   ```bash
   uv run flask db upgrade
   ```

5. Finally, run the API server, Worker, and Web frontend Server again.

# Changelog

## New Features:

- **Parallel Search Tool:** Add Parallel AI Search support for Vertex AI with native ToolParallelAiSearch integration
- **Observability:** Extended support with MLflow to have full traces observability of your agents. See [docs](https://docs.agno.com/observability/mlflow#mlflow).
- **Docling Reader:** Integrated [Docling](https://github.com/docling-project/docling) library as a new reader, enabling document processing across a multiple range of file formats.
- **WhatsApp Interface V2:**
    - Added media support (images, video, audio, documents), interactive messages (reply buttons, list menus, locations, reactions), and Team/Workflow support.
    - Users can send `/new` to start fresh conversations.
    - Added `enable_encryption` parameter for encrypting phone numbers
- **Telegram Interface:**
    - Added new Telegram interfaces for AgentOS  with support for agents, teams, and workflows.
    - Multi-modal support and use `/new` to start fresh conversations.
- **Telegram Tools:** Added new tools so agents can send photos, documents, videos, audio, animations, stickers among other things

## Improvements:

- **Workflow:**
    - Added `version` query param to `GET /workflows/{id}`to fetch specific workflow versions.
    - Added run level params like- `metadata`, `dependencies`, `add_dependencies_to_context`, `add_session_state_to_context` similar to agent/team.
- **Mistral:** Added `mistralai` v2 support while maintaining backward compatibility with v1.
- **Gemini:** Added timeout parameter to Gemini model class.

## Bug Fixes:

- `MCPTools`: Fixed race condition where parallel MCP tool calls with `header_provider` would each create duplicate sessions, causing the agent to get stuck.
- **Claude**: Fixed structured output detection for supported models
- **Streaming Tool Calls:** Fixed duplicate tool execution in streaming mode caused by shared dict references in `parse_tool_calls`
- **MongoDb:** Fixed the incorrect import of the pymongo async modules.

issue_insights.summary_brief: 本次监测到5类跨仓库共性问题：workflow_runtime（运行时崩溃/阻塞）在35个仓库中出现109例、startup_crash（启动失败）在13个仓库中出现24例、session_state（会话状态丢失）在10个仓库中出现17例、auth_permission（认证/权限缺陷）在11个仓库中出现16例、tool_call_protocol（工具调用协议问题）在11个仓库中出现15例。
global_highlights: 【workflow_runtime 运行时崩溃】P0 级共性问题：状态转换触发崩溃、工具调用失败/截断、MCP工具流超时（agno、OpenDevin、claude-code-action、opencode 等 35 仓库 109 例）
【startup_crash 启动失败】P0 级共性问题：依赖缺失/模块未打包导致无法启动（Auto-Claude、agentscope、opencode 等 13 仓库 24 例）
【auth_permission 认证缺陷】P0 级共性问题：OAuth/Token 不持久化、跨租户访问无校验、OIDC Token 交换 500 错误（claude-code、claude-code-action、OpenDevin 等 11 仓库 16 例）
【session_state 会话状态】P0 级共性问题：设置/Token 在重启后丢失、会话隔离不完整（OpenDevin、agno、claude-code 等 10 仓库 17 例）

signals.topic: Knowledge Base/VectorDB operations fail with large documents or extended usage
signals.summary: Users encounter multiple failures when working with Knowledge Base and vector databases: ChromaDB throws 'too many SQL variables' error during repeated inserts, ChromaDB rejects batches larger than 5461 documents, and LanceDB hybrid search returns duplicate documents. These issues block core knowledge management workflows.
signals.review_reason: Core workflow blocker: Knowledge base is a fundamental feature for RAG applications. Multiple users report inability to insert documents or get correct search results, which completely breaks the knowledge retrieval pipeline. High frequency (3 distinct issues) + clear reproduction steps + main flow impact.

source_issues.title: [Bug] Knowledge|ChromaDB (code: 1) too many SQL variables
source_issues.evidence: Error appears over time when inserting documents into knowledge: 'too many SQL variables'. Has reproduction steps showing failure around step 33 of document insertion.

source_issues.title: [Bug] Knowledge|ChromaDB Too many documents in batch for updating at one.
source_issues.evidence: Error inserting document: ValueError: Batch size of 5462 is greater than max batch size of 5461. Affects PDFs with >5461 pages or text files with >5461 chunks.

source_issues.title: [Bug] Knowledge|LanceDB search return duplicate documents
source_issues.evidence: Hybrid search returns duplicates: 'Teddy is brown.' returned once, 'Orange is rotten' and 'Jessica is 40 years old.' each returned twice. Has clear reproduction code.

signals.topic: MCP Tools fail in team delegation and schema handling
signals.summary: MCP tools experience two critical failure modes: (1) tools timeout when team delegates to member agents because sync run() skips connect_mcp_tools(), (2) agent output_schema incorrectly propagates to MCP tools causing invalid schema errors. Both prevent MCP tool usage in production.
signals.review_reason: MCP is a key integration protocol. These issues block users from using MCP tools in team scenarios and with structured output - both are common production patterns. Clear user impact with error messages and reproduction steps.

source_issues.title: MCP tools fail in team delegation — sync run() skips connect_mcp_tools()
source_issues.evidence: MCP tool calls timeout with: 'Timed out while waiting for response to ClientRequest. Waited 60.0 seconds.' Root cause identified: sync get_tools() path does not call connect_mcp_tools(). Has workaround and suggested fix.

source_issues.title: [Bug] Agent Output Schema being passed to MCP Tools
source_issues.evidence: API error: 'Invalid schema for function mcp_tool: In context=(properties, maturity_categories, items), schema must have a type key.' The output_schema intended for final response is incorrectly passed to MCP tool definitions.

signals.topic: Claude Sonnet 4.6 model incompatibility with Agno agents
signals.summary: Claude Sonnet 4.6 introduced a breaking change where assistant message prefilling returns 400 error. Agno's message construction relies on this pattern, causing all agents and teams using claude-sonnet-4-6 to fail with 'This model does not support assistant message prefill'.
signals.review_reason: Complete workflow blocker for users trying to use the latest Claude model. Migration to newer models is a common necessity, and this breaks all agent/team functionality. Strong evidence with official Anthropic documentation confirming the breaking change.

source_issues.title: [Bug] Claude Sonnet-4.6 incompatibility with Agno agents (assistant prefill breaking change)
source_issues.evidence: Error code 400: 'This model does not support assistant message prefill. The conversation must end with a user message.' Affects all Agno agents and teams migrating from claude-sonnet-4-5 to 4-6. Has official Anthropic migration guide reference.

signals.topic: Team sub-agent session state isolation breaks run continuation
signals.summary: When a sub-agent within a Team is paused and continued using run_id, it fails with 'No runs found for run ID' because aread_or_create_session creates a new isolated session instead of reusing the parent team's session. This breaks HITL (Human-in-the-Loop) workflows in team structures.
signals.review_reason: Breaks the Team Continue feature which is essential for Human-in-the-Loop workflows. Users cannot resume paused sub-agent tasks, blocking interactive agent applications. Has code-level root cause analysis.

source_issues.title: [Bug] [Team Continue] Sub-agent in a team fails to retrieve run history from session
source_issues.evidence: RuntimeError: No runs found for run ID {run_id}. The sub-agent creates a new session that does not contain the history of the specified run. Has code reference (libs/agno/agno/agent/_run.py:3554-3586) and reproduction steps.

signals.topic: Memory optimization can cause permanent user data loss
signals.summary: aoptimize_memories(apply=True) performs delete and insert as separate non-transactional DB calls. If connection drops after delete but before inserts complete, all user memories are permanently lost with no recovery mechanism.
signals.review_reason: Critical data integrity issue. User memory data loss is irreversible and severely impacts user trust. The issue describes a clear failure scenario (connection drop during optimization) that results in permanent data loss.

source_issues.title: bug(aoptimize_memories): delete + insert is not atomic, can lose user data
source_issues.evidence: Steps 3 (aclear_user_memories) and 4 (upsert_user_memory loop) are separate DB calls with no transaction. If connection drops after delete but before inserts complete, user memories are gone with no recovery. Clear description of data loss scenario.

signals.topic: TUI copy/paste and basic input interactions broken on Windows

signals.review_reason: Basic clipboard operations (copy/paste) are essential for daily workflow; failure blocks users from copying code snippets, error messages, or pasting content. Affects core user productivity on Windows platform.

Can cause session exits, infinite hangs, and unrecoverable states.

source_issues.title: OIDC App token exchange returning 500 Internal Server Error since Mar 18 12:00 UTC

signals.topic: Default workflow template exposes secrets on public repos
signals.summary: The default workflow template has no author_association check. On public repos, any user triggering @claude can start the workflow job, which accesses secrets and OIDC tokens before any permission check can reject them.
signals.review_reason: Critical security vulnerability with P1 label. Secrets exposure on public repos affects fundamental security posture. User impact is direct and severe.

source_issues.title: Default workflow template missing author trust gate — secrets exposed on public repos
source_issues.evidence: API keys/OAuth tokens exposed to runner environment, runner minutes consumed, OIDC token available - all before action can reject unauthorized users. Every public repo using default template is affected.

signals.topic: Action fails on repos with non-main default branch (master, etc.)

signals.review_reason: Workflow completely fails for repos with non-'main' default branch. Direct user impact blocking main functionality. P2 label but clear blocking issue.

source_issues.title: restoreConfigFromBase fails on repos with non-"main" default branch
source_issues.evidence: Action fails at config restore step before Claude even runs. Affects all repos using 'master' or non-'main' default branches.

signals.topic: Unbounded API costs on large PR scans with no useful output

signals.review_reason: Real user impact: documented monetary loss ($70+) with zero value delivered. Users cannot predict or control costs when scanning large PRs, leading to unexpected bills without actionable security findings. This meets the 'significant cost loss' pain point criteria.

source_issues.title: [FEATURE] Add configurable token budget / max cost cap to prevent runaway API bills on large PRs
source_issues.evidence: User reported $70+ total API costs across multiple scan attempts with no actionable output. Single PR scan consumed 1.3M tokens (~$8 USD) and produced zero findings. No mechanism exists to cap cumulative token usage or cost per scan.

signals.review_reason: Three distinct vector store bugs each cause complete workflow failure for users of those backends. Valkey corruption is particularly severe - permanent data corruption making memories unsearchable. Qdrant and Redis issues block core memory operations.

signals.topic: Timestamps hardcoded to US/Pacific timezone breaks date filtering

signals.review_reason: Core data integrity issue affecting all users not in Pacific timezone. Date filtering is fundamental to memory retrieval - broken behavior leads to missing relevant memories. Related to multiple other date filtering issues (#3036, #3213) suggesting broader impact.

source_issues.title: Bug: `created_at` and `updated_at` hardcoded to US/Pacific instead of UTC

signals.topic: Linux UI Freeze on Focus Loss
signals.summary: Zed freezes completely on Linux when switching applications or losing focus, requiring restart and re-occurring on subsequent focus changes
signals.review_reason: Complete UI freeze blocking all editor usage on Linux Wayland - requires restart and reproducibly re-occurs. This is a severe workflow interruption that makes the editor unusable on affected Linux systems.

source_issues.title: Freezing UI bug in Linux
source_issues.evidence: Editor freezes when focus is lost, only solution is restart, bug re-occurs if focus moves from Zed. Does not happen on Windows with same hardware (dual boot)

signals.topic: Windows Extension Language Server Installation Failure
signals.summary: Language servers fail to install from extensions on Windows with access denied (os error 5) when trying to create directories in the extensions work folder
signals.review_reason: Users cannot use extension-provided language servers on Windows due to permission issues, blocking syntax highlighting, code completion, and other IDE features for affected languages.

source_issues.title: Windows failed to install Language server
source_issues.evidence: Language server download fails with 'Access denied (os error 5)' when creating parent directory in Zed extensions work folder - affects xmake, Lua, PowerShell extensions
